schema.name: Project Snow — France Ski Data Schema
schema.description: Hierarchical ski area data model from country level down to individual lifts and pistes. Extended with 173-question resort intelligence framework across 20 themes (Overview, Getting There, Getting Around, When To Go, Ski Area, Beginners, Lift Passes, Off Piste, Families, Where To Stay, Food, Après, Beyond Skiing, Services, Costs, Safety & Access, Audiences, Comparisons, Character, Sustainability).

question_framework.description: The 173-question resort intelligence framework, mapped to schema fields and origin codes.

questions.q: How big is the ski area?
Which villages make up [resort] and how do they differ?
When was [resort] founded and how has it developed?

origin_codes.ADD: Added for coverage — not yet seen in a source

country.name: Country
country.description: Top-level geographic grouping. France has 7 ski regions across ~148 resorts.

emergency_number.description: European emergency number 112; French mountain rescue 112 or 04...; Piste patrol emergency procedures

ep_auberge_de_la_route.description: E.P. Auberge de la Route emergency contact info

region.name: Region / Massif
region.description: Mountain range or massif — the primary geographical division.

character.example: The engine room / The quiet valley / The theatre

domain.name: Linked Ski Domain
domain.description: Exists where multiple resorts share a single lift pass and connected piste network.

sourced_fields.description: Each published figure carries source_url and date_retrieved

resort.name: Resort / Station
resort.description: The commercial brand name people search for and book. One resort may contain multiple villages.

domain.description: Which linked ski area or domain is this resort part of?

weekly_cost_estimate.description: Estimated total weekly cost per person including pass, accommodation, food

value_comparison.description: How does this compare to similar resorts in value terms

expensive_rating.description: Is it expensive? Budget/mid/premium/luxury, with qualitative detail

overview.description: Overview theme: identity, reputation, founding, awards

location_description.description: Where is this resort — valley, region, near what landmarks

known_for.description: What is this resort famous/known for

luxury_detail.description: What makes it luxury: 5* hotels, Michelin dining, boutiques etc

pretty_or_concrete.description: Aesthetic judgement: pretty traditional vs functional purpose-built

real_french_village.description: Does it feel like a real French village outside ski season

history_culture.description: History and culture of the area

access.description: Getting there: airports, transfers, train, drive, EV

transfer_options.description: Bus, shuttle, taxi, private transfer options and rough costs

parking_in_out_allowed.description: Can you come and go during your stay

shuttle_bus_info.description: Free shuttle bus info and schedule

car_needed.description: Do you need a car once in resort

snow_by_month.description: Average snowfall in cm per month

weather_by_month.description: Typical weather patterns per month: temperature ranges, precipitation days, sunshine

north_facing_slopes.description: Which slopes face north and hold snow longest

ski_area.description: Ski area: runs, standout features, connections, boarder-friendly

connection_to_domain.description: How does this resort connect to the rest of the domain

miss_last_lift_info.description: What happens if you miss the last lift back

tree_runs_bad_weather.description: Best tree runs for bad weather days

long_green_run.description: Is there a long green run back to the village

beginner_jump.description: Big jump from nursery slopes to next level

ski_school_booking_half_term.description: How early to book for half term

guide_needed.description: Do you need a guide for off piste

which_village_to_stay.description: Which village is right for different types

booking_advice.description: Do I need to book in advance

bakeries.description: Bakeries and where to find them

folie_douce.description: Is there a Folie Douce and where

beyond_skiing.description: Non-ski activities, events, summer, bad weather

activity_highlights.description: Highlight activities beyond skiing (paragliding, ice skating, dog sledding, etc)

ski_hire_info.description: Where are the hire shops near accommodation

ski_patrol_collection.description: Where to collect skis taken by ski patrol after injury

medical_centre_notes.description: Notes about medical cover (village level has precise location)

pharmacy_notes.description: Notes about pharmacy access (village level has precise location)

supermarket_notes.description: Supermarket info (village level has boolean presence)

ski_insurance_carre_neige.description: Do I need ski insurance or Carré Neige

comparison_within_domain.description: How does it compare to other resorts in same domain

smaller_vs_larger.description: Is a smaller resort better than huge linked area

rival_comparison.description: How does this compare to a named rival resort

audience.description: Audience suitability — who this resort works for (moved from domain level: these are resort-specific, not domain-wide)

bed_capacity.description: Total bed capacity across the resort (was accommodation.bed_capacity)

accommodation_type_mix.description: Mix of hotels, chalets, apartments (was accommodation.type_mix)

village.name: Village / Altitude Band
village.description: The altitude band within a resort. Maximum differentiation between villages lives here.

sun_exposure.description: Which part of day does it get sun

vibe.description: Lively, sporty, functional, young-at-heart, exclusive, family

home_network.description: How much terrain is reachable without traverses or bus transfers

lifts.description: Lifts departing from or arriving at this village

lift.name: Chairlift / Aerialway
lift.description: Individual lift infrastructure. One lift connects two points on the mountain.

piste.name: Piste / Ski Run
piste.description: A named ski run with difficulty rating.

cross_cutting.description: Content types that apply across multiple levels

audience_fit.description: Standardised scores for key audience segments (0-10)

cross_cutting_definitions.description: Defined metadata types for cross-cutting scoring, media, and provenance

snow_reliability_score.description: 0-10 score measuring how reliably the resort holds snow through the season

methodology.description: How this score is calculated: altitude, aspect, glacier, snowmaking combined

wow_factor.description: 0-10 score for scenic beauty, mountain drama, and spectacle

restaurant_score.description: 0-10 dining quality score combining quality, variety, and value

apres_score.description: 0-10 score for after-ski scene — bars, clubs, energy

audience_fit_scores.description: Standardised 0-10 fit scores per audience segment

photo_essay.description: Curated set of photos for editorial display

subject.description: What this photo shows: piste, village, mountain, restaurant, activity

video.description: Video content — POV runs, resort tours, drone footage

q_and_a_responses.description: Provenance-tracked answers to the 173-question framework per resort

answer_count.description: How many of the 173 questions have been answered for this resort

answered_by.description: Human, AI, or automated pipeline that generated the answers

answers.description: Map of question framework fields to answers with confidence

generated_content_notes.description: Provenance tracking for AI-generated content — critical for editorial integrity
